name: review-run-metadataroot-hash
title: Fix review-run material/story hashes computed with wrong metadataRoot on wrapper-root + custom storyDir
description: review_run_start signs review-run material/story hashes and freshness checks from signedWorkspaceRoot instead of the resolved metadataRoot. On a wrapper-root layout (metadataRoot != gitRoot) with a custom storyDir, story-metadata paths are wrongly folded into materialHash/storyFilesHash on BOTH the production side (captureReviewRunSnapshot) and the consumer freshness side (assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence / validateEvidenceRunBinding). A metadata-only commit to the custom storyDir then falsely flags the review run stale, and the hash semantics diverge from the DONE gate / quorum / validation. Plain repo / default storyDir are unaffected.
